title: Group-level DYN feature-budget search on frozen E08 features

selection.criterion: highest mean validation Macro-F1 among subsets with 30-40 features
selection.tie_break: smallest subset within 0.10 percentage points of the best eligible subset

hgb_params_source: E08 seed_results dyn_hgb/40p selected_params; fixed per seed, no re-tuning
notes: Uses only cached train/validation features from E08; no raw-sequence rescan and no model retraining beyond HGB.
The 40% training subset is the frozen E08 train_ids_40p.npy for each seed.
All 63 non-empty combinations of the six frozen feature groups are evaluated.
Validation-only analysis; test split is neither read nor scored.
This is a feature-budget screen, not a replacement for the full E08/E12 protocol.
